div.head: Iud Dei XIII 4.1
div.ab: Postea uero communicet illos quos uult mittere in aquam et (dum communicauerint) dicat (sacerdos) per singulos: Corpus domini nostri Iesu Christi sit tibi ad probationem hodie!
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 422–423 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

div.ab: But afterwards let him communicate those whom he wishes to send into the water, and (while they communicate) let (the priest) say to each one: May the body of our Lord Jesus Christ be to you for a proof today!
